scheme.name: Italian open-system barriers: Milan ring roads (Milano Serravalle - Milano Tangenziali) and the A32 Torino-Bardonecchia (SITAF)

dataset.method: A fixed toll to the user per passage by class (A, B by height for two axles; 3, 4, 5 by axles), VAT included, from 1 January 2026. Milano Serravalle - Milano Tangenziali's tolls at the barriers of its semi-closed ring roads: A50 Tangenziale Ovest di Milano, Terrazzano barrier class 5 EUR 8.40; A51 Tangenziale Est di Milano, Vimercate barrier class 5 EUR 4.90; A52 Tangenziale Nord di Milano, Sesto San Giovanni barrier class 5 EUR 6.30. The ring roads' other km carry no toll; the barrier tolls include Autostrade per l'Italia's share where the table gives one. SITAF's tolls at the A32's two barriers, the open motorway's only toll stations (Avigliana for Rivoli-Susa, Salbertrand for Susa-Bardonecchia): Avigliana class 5 EUR 15.90; Salbertrand class 5 EUR 21.70 (Avigliana's are SITAF's unit rate per km, ANAS fee and 22% VAT times the barrier's 34.47 km, rounded to 10 cents). Each barrier is placed at the centre of its toll booths in OpenStreetMap (by name; the Vimercate booths, unnamed, as those within 1 km of the Vimercate Sud junction).
